Task: Audit Logs System Implementation Across All Required Users
Reason: The system lacked a central security log to monitor what super admins institute staff and teachers do across the platform.
Changes Made: Created migration 141 and full backend audit log system with routes controllers and permissions. Built the Audit Logs page with role-based visibility across SaaS super admin institute admin and branch views.

Reason: The counsellor dashboard layout needed visual cleanups and better spacing for daily admission and enquiry follow-ups.
Changes Made: Updated the counsellor dashboard interface with cleaner cards improved alignment removed redundant paddings and made quick actions more accessible.

Reason: Teachers faced issues where branch course and batch dropdown filters did not update properly when creating homework assignments.
Changes Made: Fixed the dependent filter state and query logic in the homework creation screen so selecting a course accurately filters the corresponding branches and batches without resetting.

Task: Audit Log Diffs & Popup Story Representation
Reason: Audit logs were not saving previous values on updates and the popup was full of raw code parameters that were hard to read.
Changes Made: Added pre-update database snapshotting to show previous vs updated field changes side-by-side. Designed a clear story banner at the top explaining who did what in simple English and collapsed technical diagnostics.

Task: Making Product Analytics Page Fully Dynamic
Reason: The Product Analytics dashboard had hardcoded fake numbers and static rows that did not reflect actual platform usage.
Changes Made: Connected the entire analytics page to real database data. Built the module usage engine from live audit activity with tenant-wise filtering and timeline options for Last Month Last Year and Total All-Time.

Task: Forgot Password OTP Verification Flow & Security Hardening
Reason: Users needed a secure OTP-based password reset mechanism with strict expiry single-use tokens and a clean professional UI.
Changes Made: Implemented 6-digit OTP generation with 5-minute expiry in authModel.js. Added single-use resetToken issuance upon successful OTP verification to block direct password reset attempts. Added animated checkmark confirmation timer countdown clean business-oriented UI without emojis and transactional email template.

Task: Institute Registration Form Wizard & KYC Document Upload
Reason: Institutes registering via public onboarding needed to submit mandatory KYC documents (Registration Proof PAN Admin ID) and optional files (GST Logo) directly during sign-up.
Changes Made: Added database columns (reg_doc_url pan_doc_url admin_id_doc_url gst_doc_url logo_url) to saas_leads and tenants. Configured multer file upload middleware for PDF JPG PNG files. Built a 4-step wizard in RegisterTenant.tsx with dedicated document KYC upload cards progress indicators and multipart form submission.

Task: SaaS Lead View Documents Section & Full Document Viewer Modal
Reason: Super admins inspecting leads needed a clear view of uploaded documents and ability to inspect PDFs or images directly in the browser.
Changes Made: Added KYC & Verification Documents section to the Lead Details view in Leads.tsx with a clean structured table showing document heading type compulsory vs optional status and action. Built an embedded 4xl preview modal with PDF reader image viewer open in new tab and download options.
